title: Albumin–adiposity coupling and inflammatory-state prediction: an exploratory cross-survey test
abstract: Adding a centered albumin × BMI interaction changed transported weighted Brier loss from 0.175636 to 0.175422 (delta -0.000213; approximate joint PSU bootstrap95% [-0.000546,+0.000147]); improvement was not established under the registered criterion. Exploratory representation test fitted in NHANES III and transported to separately recruited NHANES2017–2018, not untouched confirmation or a new biomarker.
